isolation: The todo list is a single global, unauthenticated in-memory list with no per-user/per-session container and one pre-existing todo ('via webapp /api on read-only template') not created by this run. Each scenario creates the specific todos it asserts about (using exact, scenario-distinct titles) and asserts only on those items by id/content, or on the delta in total count across its own Given+When actions, rather than on the absolute list state. The 'Viewing an empty list' scenario's Given ('no todos have been added') could not be reached this way since nothing could be asserted as a delta (the When is read-only), and deleting the pre-existing todo to force a literal empty state was out of scope (not this run's data to delete) — that scenario is reported blocked.

scenarios.rule: The todo list shows every todo in creation order, oldest first

steps.command: agent-browser fill @e9 "Buy groceries" && agent-browser click @e3 (Add); agent-browser fill @e13 "Read a book" && agent-browser click @e3 (Add)
steps.observed: both todos appeared as new rows in the UI immediately after each Add click

steps.text: the User views the todo list
steps.observed: fresh page load re-fetched and rendered the list

steps.text: "Buy groceries" appears before "Read a book" in the list
steps.observed: ["via webapp /api on read-only template3 minutes ago", "Buy groceriesJust now", "Read a bookJust now"] — Buy groceries row precedes Read a book row

scenarios.rule: The todo list shows every todo in creation order, oldest first

steps.text: no todos have been added
steps.observed: count: 1 — a pre-existing todo ('via webapp /api on read-only template', id d6387a6303cbe092e8450fccda269b54, created before this run started) is already present in the shared global list. This list has no per-user/per-session scoping, so a truly empty state cannot be reached without deleting that pre-existing item, which was not created by this run and is out of scope to delete.

evidence.notCaptured: the Given state (empty list) could not be established through the UI or the API without deleting data this run did not create, so the When/Then were never attempted

scenarios.rule: A new todo is added with a title and starts as not done
scenarios.scenario: Adding a todo with a title

steps.text: no todos have been added
steps.observed: baseline count recorded as 3 (shared global list already held other items from the prior scenario and the pre-existing seed todo); isolation is via delta from this baseline, not a literal zero

steps.text: the User adds a todo titled "Walk the dog"
steps.command: agent-browser fill @e17 "Walk the dog" && agent-browser click @e3 (Add) && agent-browser wait --text "Walk the dog" --timeout 10000
steps.observed: new row "Walk the dog" appeared

steps.text: the list has exactly one todo
steps.observed: 4 — exactly one more than the baseline of 3, i.e. exactly one todo was added

steps.text: that todo is titled "Walk the dog" and is not done
steps.observed: {'id': 'a70c64debfc7a333fd3a91646ac7e783', 'title': 'Walk the dog', 'done': False, 'createdAt': '2026-10-01T14:00:20.725679348Z'}

scenarios.rule: A new todo is added with a title and starts as not done

steps.text: no todos have been added
steps.observed: baseline count recorded as 4 before the attempt; isolation is via delta (unchanged count), not a literal zero

steps.text: the User tries to add a todo with a blank title
steps.command: agent-browser click @e3 (Add, with the title textbox empty)
steps.observed: click succeeded (exit 0) but no POST to /api/todos fired

steps.text: the list is still empty
steps.command: agent-browser get count "tbody tr"; agent-browser network requests | grep -i todos
steps.observed: count remained 4 (unchanged from baseline), and the network log shows only the 3 earlier POST /api/todos calls (201) from prior adds — no new POST was made for the blank-title click, confirming the UI refused to submit it
